_comment: Career tiers. Objectives must all be met to be promoted to the next tier. Kinds: jobs (distinct briefs finished with at least minStars), flow (best flow score on a building type).

tiers.name: Rookie
tiers.unlocks: Basic walls, flooring, doors and windows; houses and corner stores.

tiers.name: Local firm
tiers.unlocks: Stairs, more themes, mid-tier decor; larger houses, a retail boutique and a small cafe.

tiers.name: Regional
tiers.unlocks: Elevators, checkouts, bar and stage pieces; duplexes, grocery stores and nightclubs.

tiers.name: Established
tiers.unlocks: Dock doors, conveyors and forklifts; apartment buildings, big-box retail and shipping.

tiers.name: Elite
tiers.unlocks: Luxury decor and premium finishes; mansions, high-rises and flagship stores.
